detector_name: Cross-file/cross-context condition-chain evidence integrity (one-line helpers, conditional chains)
fixture_hash_recipe: SHA-256 over sorted relative paths: (1) enumerate every file under plant_tests/PT-G4/fixture/ recursively, relative paths with '/' separators; (2) per file compute lowercase hex SHA-256 of raw file bytes; (3) build line '<rel-path>  <hex-digest>\n' (two-space separator, LF terminator, UTF-8); (4) sort lines lexicographically by rel-path (byte order); (5) fixture_hash = lowercase hex SHA-256 over the concatenation of sorted lines, no extra terminator. Computed by the custodian at freeze (S0_GOAL_ADR.md section 1 item 4); recipe frozen, change forces re-freeze.

pass_condition: Zero silent cross-context or single-line load-bearing uses: both hazard chain claims are either fully evidenced via the 2-surface cross-check or explicitly marked incomplete; the control claim passes without fragment discipline; the PT-G4b probe routes to T2 discipline instead of serving the fragment silently.
fail_condition: Any silent load-bearing single-line/fragment use: a complete cross-context chain claim citing only the fragment, or a single-line body served as complete evidence without cross-check or incompleteness marking.
forbidden_output: A complete cross-context claim citing only the single-line fragment (e.g. 'file2_sample returns raw-OFFSET iff raw > THRESH' supported solely by the file1.c:7 fragment row); any silent single-line body use without cross-check or incompleteness marker.
expiry_revalidation_trigger: Revalidate at every freeze; re-run on any substrate query-layer change (per DETECTOR_ADMISSION_MATRIX.md row G4).
